code_path.future_filter: buyable_mask.shift(-1) and shortable_mask.shift(-1), which use next-day open, pause, limit, volume, close and traded-amount state
code_path.position: positions[t] are filtered by those next-day masks and multiplied by the close-to-close target

source_2_pit_refutation.reason: The selection at t conditions on t+1 execution state, and the credited close-to-close return includes the overnight move before a next-open execution could occur. The published 8/101 net-positive count is therefore not point-in-time and cannot evidence alpha efficacy.
mt5_translation_via_translate_to_mt5: neutralize by MT5 asset class and currency-risk bucket

exact_mt5_analogue.symbols: Every contemporaneously tradable Fusion symbol from the terminal registry; no hardcoded boundary
exact_mt5_analogue.fields: decision-time bid/ask or OHLCV, symbol trade/session status known at decision time, contract_size, tick_size, tick_value, point value, long/short swap and commission
exact_mt5_analogue.timeframe: D1 for a literal daily transfer; intraday variants must be separately preregistered
exact_mt5_analogue.execution: If the signal is fixed at D1 close t and execution occurs at next tradable quote/open, PnL begins at that executable bid/ask, not close[t]; no t+1 availability/spread filter may enter selection before it is observed
exact_mt5_analogue.costs: Fusion-symbol-specific spread plus commission, slippage/partial-fill markout and swap across held rollovers; the source's flat 10 bps is not executable-cost evidence
exact_mt5_analogue.point_in_time: Universe membership, group labels, trade/session state and costs must be as known at the decision/execution timestamp; unavailable future state is OFF/UNMEASURED, never backfilled
